title: Configuration Explosion (The 40,000 Variables Nightmare)
pattern: Exporting every trivial visual property, UI asset, or non-volatile design logic variable to config tables or files.
why_bad: Drastically slows down development velocity. Adding a single field requires implementing the layout, properties fields, database migration, and operator testing. It forces developers to manage thousands of untested runtime variables.
detection: The presence of massive configuration schemas containing hundreds of low-severity variables or cosmetic styles.
fix: Do not push decisions to configuration out of laziness or indecision; hardcode sensible defaults in compilation structures, using real-world testing to lock in decisions.
source: [2nd] Andrew Hunt_ David Hurst Thomas - *The Pragmatic Programmer_ Your Journey to Mastery*, 20th Anniversary Edition (2019, Addison-Wesley Professional).pdf, Topic 32.
